Mathematical_Expression: H_i^n for all grounded cells i in [1..g(n)]
Computed_From: Previous timestep state or initial condition
Role_in_Budget: State vector initialisation
Anti_Double_Count_Note: N/A — read-only load

Mathematical_Expression: x_GL^n = i_g * Delta_x + lambda_g^n * Delta_x
Computed_From: Grounded-cell pointer i_g and partial-cell fraction lambda_g^n
Role_in_Budget: Moving-boundary state
Anti_Double_Count_Note: N/A — read-only load

Mathematical_Expression: lambda_g^n in (0,1]
Computed_From: Previous timestep moving-boundary update
Role_in_Budget: Controls fractional grounded volume in terminal cell
Anti_Double_Count_Note: N/A — read-only load

Mathematical_Expression: g(n) — index of the terminal partially-grounded cell
Computed_From: Previous moving-boundary update
Role_in_Budget: Defines domain extent
Anti_Double_Count_Note: N/A — read-only load

Mathematical_Expression: Solve: d/dx[2 H nu_eff du/dx] - tau_b(u) - tau_lat(u) = rho_i g H ds/dx  subject to: stress-free at calving front; u=u_upstream at divide or Neumann inflow
Units: u in m s^-1; nu_eff in Pa s; tau in Pa
Computed_From: H_i^n (geometry); T_ice (temperature); C_bed (basal); W_i (width)
Role_in_Budget: Provides velocity field for flux computation — DIAGNOSTIC STEP (no state update here)
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Velocity computed from geometry at t_n only. No state variable modified in this step.

Mathematical_Expression: nu_eff_i = B_i / (2 * |du/dx|^((n-1)/n))  with Kelvin regularisation: |du/dx| -> sqrt(du/dx)^2 + epsilon_reg^2)  where epsilon_reg = 1e-15 s^-1
Computed_From: u_i^n from Step 2; Glen rate factor B_i; n=3
Role_in_Budget: Required for SSA operator — feeds back to Step 2 via Picard iteration
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Diagnostic only; no state update

Mathematical_Expression: Iterate Steps 2-3a until: Res_Picard = ||u^(k+1) - u^(k)|| / (||u^(k)|| + u_scale) <= 1e-5  where u_scale = 10 m yr^-1; max iterations = 25
Computed_From: Successive Picard iterates
Role_in_Budget: Convergence criterion — empirical engineering limit; not mathematically guaranteed
Anti_Double_Count_Note: If not converged in 25 iterations: flag RSK_NUM_07; halve Delta_t and retry

Mathematical_Expression: q_GL^n = C_schoof * (rho_i g / 4B)^n * ((1 - rho_i/rho_w) * rho_i g)^n * H_GL^(n+1)  [Schoof 2007 Eq. 29; n=3; C_schoof dimensionless ~0.61]
Computed_From: H_GL = H_{g(n)}^n (terminal cell thickness); B (Glen stiffness); rho_i; rho_w; g
Role_in_Budget: Grounding-line calving-front outflux — the ADVECTIVE discharge term Q_GL
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Q_GL = W_GL * q_GL is the advective discharge. It is applied as the OUTFLOW boundary condition for the Eulerian FV transport in Step 5. It is NOT added again anywhere else.

Mathematical_Expression: Q_GL^n = W_GL^n * q_GL^n
Computed_From: W_GL^n = channel width at grounding line; q_GL^n from Step 4a
Role_in_Budget: Enters mass budget as -rho_i * Q_GL * Delta_t
Anti_Double_Count_Note: This is the pure ICE-VELOCITY contribution. The boundary-migration contribution (Step 8) is SEPARATE and arises only from geometry remapping.

Mathematical_Expression: Q_{i+1/2}^n = W_{i+1/2} * H_{i+1/2}^upwind * u_{i+1/2}^n  where H^upwind = H_i^n if u_{i+1/2} >= 0 else H_{i+1}^n
Computed_From: u from Step 2; H^n from Step 1; W from geometry
Role_in_Budget: Advective flux across each interior cell face — feeds Eulerian transport
Anti_Double_Count_Note: First-order upwind in Phase 5.2.2.7. No geometric-velocity term is added here.

Operation_Name: Compute SMB source term per cell
Mathematical_Expression: S_i^n = dot_b_i^n * W_i * Delta_x  where dot_b = SMB rate [m s^-1 ice equivalent]
Computed_From: RACMO2 or CESM2 downscaled SMB field (monthly); linearly interpolated to t_n
Role_in_Budget: Surface accumulation/ablation source — enters mass budget as +S_i * Delta_t
Anti_Double_Count_Note: SMB is not tied to geometry migration; computed on fixed cells.

Operation_Name: Eulerian FV transport for interior cells (i < g(n))
Mathematical_Expression: H_i^(n+1,*) = H_i^n + (Delta_t / (W_i * Delta_x)) * [Q_{i-1/2}^n - Q_{i+1/2}^n + S_i^n]  (* denotes pre-remapping intermediate state)
Computed_From: Q face fluxes from Step 5a; S from Step 5b; fixed grid
Role_in_Budget: PROGNOSTIC update of ice thickness on fixed Eulerian grid
Anti_Double_Count_Note: NO moving-mesh velocity appears in this step. The H* field is an intermediate; grounded/floating designation is updated in Step 7.

Operation_Name: Eulerian FV transport for terminal cell i=g(n)
Mathematical_Expression: H_g^(n+1,*) = H_g^n + (Delta_t / (W_g * lambda_g^n * Delta_x)) * [Q_{g-1/2}^n - Q_GL^n + S_g^n]  Note: effective volume = W_g * lambda_g^n * Delta_x
Computed_From: Q_{g-1/2} from Step 5a; Q_GL from Step 4b; lambda_g^n from Step 1c
Role_in_Budget: PROGNOSTIC update of terminal partial cell; volume scaled by partial-cell fraction
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Q_GL used here IS the advective discharge from Step 4b. The boundary-migration term Delta_M_boundary is computed AFTER remapping in Step 8 from x_GL change — it is not subtracted here.

Operation_Name: Compute SMB mass sum for diagnostic
Mathematical_Expression: Mdot_SMB^n = rho_i * sum_i(S_i^n)
Computed_From: S_i^n from Step 5b
Role_in_Budget: Enters diagnostic conservation residual
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Diagnostic accumulator only; not a state update

Units: For each cell i: float_i = True if H_i^(n+1,*) < (rho_w / rho_i) * max(0, z_sl - z_b_i)  where z_sl = current sea level; z_b_i = bed elevation
Computed_From: boolean mask
Role_in_Budget: H* from Steps 5c-5d; bed topography from BedMachine V4.1 (500 m); sea level from forcing
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Determines which cells are grounded vs floating after transport — defines x_GL^(n+1)
column8: This is the FLOTATION REMAPPING step. It converts a thickness change into a domain geometry change. It does not add or subtract mass; it reclassifies cells.

Mathematical_Expression: x_GL^(n+1) = i_g^(n+1) * Delta_x + lambda_g^(n+1) * Delta_x  where i_g^(n+1) = last fully grounded cell; lambda_g^(n+1) in (0,1] is the linear interpolation fraction satisfying the flotation criterion at the sub-cell level
Computed_From: float mask from Step 7a; H* field; bed topography
Role_in_Budget: Moving-boundary state update
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Linear sub-cell interpolation: lambda_g^(n+1) = (H_crit - H_{g+1}^*) / (H_g^* - H_{g+1}^*) where H_crit = rho_w/rho_i * (z_sl - z_b_g). Clipped to [0

Operation_Name: Compute grounding-line migration velocity and boundary mass term
Mathematical_Expression: v_GL^n = (x_GL^(n+1) - x_GL^n) / Delta_t  Delta_M_boundary^n = rho_i * W_GL^n * H_GL^n * v_GL^n * Delta_t
Computed_From: x_GL values from Steps 1b and 7b; W_GL; H_GL^n
Role_in_Budget: Reynolds Transport boundary-migration contribution — DIAGNOSTIC accounting term
Anti_Double_Count_Note: CRITICAL: Delta_M_boundary is derived SOLELY from the change in domain geometry (x_GL change). It is NOT subtracted from the thickness field. The Eulerian transport in Steps 5c-5d uses Q_GL (ice velocity). There is no double counting.

Mathematical_Expression: If lambda_g^(n+1) <= 0: (full ungrounding of terminal cell)  Delta_M_unground = rho_i * W_g * H_g^(n+1,*) * Delta_x  g(n+1) = g(n) - 1  lambda_g^(n+1) = 1.0 (new terminal cell is now fully grounded)  Floating ledger += Delta_M_unground
Role_in_Budget: *) from Step 5d; cell geometry
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Transfers mass from grounded to floating reservoir when full cell ungrounds
column8: Mass is CONSERVED: M_gr decreases by Delta_M_unground; floating ledger increases by same amount. No mass created or destroyed.

Mathematical_Expression: If lambda_g^(n+1) > 0 and lambda_g^(n+1) < lambda_g^n:  g(n+1) = g(n) (pointer unchanged)  Volume_lost = rho_i * W_g * H_g^(n+1,*) * (lambda_g^n - lambda_g^(n+1)) * Delta_x  Floating ledger += Volume_lost
Computed_From: lambda values from Steps 1c and 7b
Role_in_Budget: Partial retreat: volume of ice that crossed grounding line during this step
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Mass CONSERVED: grounded domain shrinks; floating gains equivalent mass.

Mathematical_Expression: Full grounding (lambda_g^(n+1) >= 1):  g(n+1) = g(n) + 1  Newly grounded cell mass = rho_i * W_{g+1} * H_{g+1}^n * lambda_{g+1}^(n+1) * Delta_x  Floating ledger -= (newly grounded mass)  Normal advance (lambda_g^(n+1) > lambda_g^n but < 1): g(n+1) = g(n); floating ledger decreases by newly grounded partial volume
Computed_From: H_{g+1}^n from floating ledger / BedMachine; lambda values
Role_in_Budget: Source reservoir is EXPLICITLY the floating ice at cell g+1 — not from vacuum. Mass removed from floating and added to grounded ledger.
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Mass CONSERVED: floating decreases; grounded increases by same amount.

Operation_Name: Compute grounded ice mass from prognostic cell volumes
Mathematical_Expression: M_gr(t_{n+1}) = rho_i * sum_{i=1}^{g(n+1)-1} [W_i * Delta_x * H_i^(n+1)] + rho_i * W_g * lambda_g^(n+1) * Delta_x * H_g^(n+1)
Computed_From: H^(n+1) from Steps 5c-5d (after retreat/advance bookkeeping); lambda_g^(n+1); g(n+1)
Role_in_Budget: Prognostic grounded mass — primary state variable
Anti_Double_Count_Note: Direct summation over all grounded cells. This is the ground truth for the mass budget.

Mathematical_Expression: Delta_M_cons(t_{n+1}) = M_gr(t_{n+1}) - M_gr(t_n) - Delta_t * Mdot_SMB^n + Delta_t * rho_i * Q_GL^n - Delta_M_boundary^n  Should equal zero (or machine precision) for exact arithmetic
Computed_From: M_gr from Steps 10 and load; Mdot_SMB from Step 6; Q_GL from Step 4b; Delta_M_boundary from Step 8
Role_in_Budget: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — not a state update. Verifies that all terms sum to zero.
Anti_Double_Count_Note: If |Delta_M_cons| > epsilon_mach * M_gr: flag error RSK_NUM_08; halt and report. This is a bookkeeping integrity check on the specification arithmetic — NOT a physical validation.
